required_columns.description: Globally unique raw time-point identifier.
Study-scoped primary-human-hepatocyte donor identifier.
Calibration, internal validation, or independent held-out assignment.
Stable DOI, PMID, accession, or repository identifier.
Exact figure, table, raw-file row, well, field, and time-point locator.
SHA-256 digest of the source raw-data artifact.
SHA-256 digest of the split manifest fixed before model evaluation.
Development-open or sealed-heldout state.
Must be Homo sapiens.
Exact primary-human-hepatocyte preparation.
Exact 2D, sandwich, spheroid, organoid, perfused, or in-situ context.
Healthy donor and exclusion context.
Biological replicate identifier; not a synthetic donor.
Identifier joining one pool's time course in one biological replicate.
Exact ID from the compartment-resolved energy/redox pool registry.
Exact molecule token declared by the selected pool.
Exact compartment token declared by the selected pool.
Direct compartment-targeting or validated fractionation method.
Directly validated or explicitly not independently validated.
Exact acquisition and analysis assay.
Exact sensor, probe, mass-spectrometry method, electrode, or optode.
Same-assay calibrated, source calibration reported, or uncalibrated.
Finite non-negative elapsed seconds.
Finite source-reported value without inferred conversion.
Original source unit.
Concentration, calibrated signal/ratio, pressure, redox, or membrane potential.
Raw, mean, median, fitted estimate, or exact source statistic.
Finite non-negative source-reported uncertainty.
Original uncertainty unit.
SD, SEM, CI, range, posterior interval, or exact definition.
Non-negative integer source sample size.
Finite non-negative oxygen context measured or controlled for the same record.
Original oxygen-context unit.
Complete glucose, amino-acid, lipid, hormone, and medium context.
Viability and phenotype context at this time point.
Cell region, zonation, field, or spatial coordinate context.

conditional_columns.description: Finite assay temperature in degrees Celsius when reported.
Exact baseline or normalization definition; null for absolute values.
Detection limit, censoring, exclusion, or missingness statement.
ID joining simultaneously acquired pools in the same cell.
Matched compartment volume when directly measured.
